reason: The README clearly presents a testing plugin that generates unit tests, runs project test runners, parses failures, and fixes only its generated test files through a bounded loop.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 生成、运行并在有限迭代内修复项目单元测试。
summaries.en: Generates, runs, and iteratively fixes project unit tests within a bounded loop for DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Generates unit-test files from project source targets
Runs the project's configured or detected test runner
Iteratively fixes failures in generated test files using an optional LLM
Writes generated test files while skipping existing tests
Provides a slash command and model tool for test generation
